# ex: needParen when binary expr replaces call function
ex {
	import "strings"
	var x string
	strings.TrimSpace(x) -> strings.TrimSpace(x + " ")
}
-- x.go --
package m

import "strings"

func F(s string) string {
	return strings.TrimSpace(s)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 import "strings"

 func F(s string) string {
-	return strings.TrimSpace(s)
+	return strings.TrimSpace(s + " ")
 }
